title: A Memory-Efficient Distributed Algorithm for Approximate Nearest Neighbour Search with Arbitrary Distances
abstract: arXiv:2405.13795v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Approximate nearest neighbour (ANN) search has become a central task in modern data-intensive applications, particularly when operating on large-scale, heterogeneous, or high-dimensional datasets. However, many existing ANN methods struggle in such scenarios, either because they rely on metric assumptions or because their indexing strategies are not well suited to distributed environments or to settings with constrained memory resources. This work introduces PDASC (Parametrizable Distributed Approximate Similarity Search with Clustering), a distributed ANN search algorithm whose index design jointly addresses three concerns commonly treated separately in the ANN literature: support for arbitrary dissimilarity functions, native distributed execution, and efficient operation under constrained memory environments, avoiding reliance on specialised hardware accelerators or costly memory resources. translated_title: 一种支持任意距离、内存高效的分布式近似最近邻搜索算法
translated_abstract: 近似最近邻（ANN）搜索已成为现代数据密集型应用中的核心任务，尤其是在处理大规模、异构或高维数据集时。然而，许多现有的ANN方法在这类场景下表现不佳，原因要么是它们依赖于度量性假设，要么是其索引策略并不适合分布式环境或内存资源受限的设置。本工作提出了PDASC（Parametrizable Distributed Approximate Similarity Search with Clustering，可参数化的基于聚类的分布式近似相似性搜索），这是一种分布式ANN搜索算法，其索引设计同时解决了ANN文献中通常被分开处理的三个问题：支持任意的不相似性函数、原生分布式执行，以及在内存受限环境下的高效运行，且无需依赖专用硬件加速器或昂贵的内存资源。PDASC构建了一个分布式层次化索引……
tldr: 本文提出分布式近似最近邻搜索算法PDASC，其索引设计同时支持任意不相似性度量、原生分布式执行以及内存受限环境下的高效运行，且无需专用硬件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PDASC, a distributed approximate nearest neighbour search algorithm whose index design simultaneously supports arbitrary dissimilarity functions, native distributed execution, and efficient operation under constrained memory without specialised hardware.
